mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic demand, which positively impacts corporate earnings and drives S&P 500 forward returns higher over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not higher than baseline during GDP growth periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and higher S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative when unemployment is below 4% in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both GDP (GDPC1) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase, it indicates economic growth with tightening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
regime_hint: economic expansion with tightening monetary policy
failure_condition: No positive correlation between GDP and FEDFUNDS growth and S&P 500 returns (correlation < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals increased supply and productivity, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are not higher during industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Growth in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased economic activity and higher S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: No positive correlation between payroll growth and S&P 500 returns (correlation < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate investment (RSAFS) indicates strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative when RSAFS growth exceeds 5% in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2%, it indicates a tightening labor market and potential monetary policy changes, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: No negative correlation between UNRATE below 4% and FEDFUNDS above 2% with S&P 500 returns (correlation > -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are not higher during housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).
